item.title: Ruri 0.9.0-beta
item.description: - test(cli): respect the resolved authorization language (d9b8e0a) - chore(release): bump version to 0.9.0-beta (14df357) - feat(cli): offer compact first-launch installation (918ccb7) - test(cli): verify English defaults in the distributed app (36abbf9) - feat(cli): default to English independently of the app language (cf498af) - test(cli): verify concise discovery and text output in packaged apps (7bbe33c) - feat(cli): render concise text results and actionable diagnostics (94b81f6) - feat(cli): add grouped command help and focused schema discovery (6c2e034) - fix(settings): clarify CLI copy and space installation details (c19c07f) - fix(cli): render requested command help and simplify installation copy (2110780) - fix(cli): install into the standard command path with guided authorization (ee29003) - fix(app): refresh derived settings after shared state commits (bcd0c3c) - fix(cli): include actionable recovery details in failed operations (94dab94) - test(cli): verify signed packages on both supported architectures (e486f28) - fix(core): preserve concurrent CLI edits in GUI configuration drafts (c16793e) - feat(cli): finalize discovery installation UI and packaged acceptance checks (b6117c7) - feat(cli): add resource pack world and recovery commands (2ff1bff) - feat(cli): share account authentication and monitored game launching (d7c783e) - feat(cli): expose instance directory and Java management (7c5b046) - feat(cli): add atomic configuration patches and inheritance inspection (ed1ee07) - feat(cli): add typed command protocol and bundled CLI infrastructure (7eb468c) - chore: streamline tests and build tooling (f9904b6) - fix(update): publish the appcast through a gh-pages branch (85909a2)
